g.text: 1. Prepare and freeze the synthetic benchmark
192 states / five fields / template-derived, AI-reviewed targets
Preserve provenance and canonical dataset fingerprint

g.text: 2. Split by Location/NPC pair - seeds 42, 43, 44
144 train / 24 validation / 24 test per seed
All field values seen in training; pairs kept in one subset

g.text: 3a. Train four model configurations
char-output / char-full / words-flat / words-slots
Fit vocabulary on training data only
Select checkpoints using validation event NLL
Finish all training before multi-seed test evaluation

g.text: 3b. Build the retrieval baseline
Retrieve events from training targets only
Use matching split and seed
No model training or validation selection
Evaluate on the same held-out test states
